snippet.title: Doctor Havoc SAGE 2026 Trailer
snippet.description:
Doctor Havoc will be at SAGE 2026 with a new gameplay demo for you all to try. Featuring 8 levels, and plenty of new things to do!
https://sonicfangameshq.com/forums/showcase/doctor-havoc-sage-26-demo.3082/
The game itself is nearing it's completion so please wait just a little bit longer 
Enjoy!
